sections.skill: Spot stereotypes in generated content and plan review

questions.prompt: What is a stereotype?

choices.text: An oversimplified idea about a group
A detailed and accurate description of one individual person, based on facts about them

questions.correct_answer: An oversimplified idea about a group
questions.intro: Generated text and images can repeat STEREOTYPES: oversimplified ideas about groups. Ask for "a doctor" and get only men; "a nurse" and get only women; "a family" and get only one kind of family; or stories where certain groups always play the same roles. These come from patterns in training data. Spot them by looking across SEVERAL outputs, not just one, and asking: Who is shown? In what roles? Who is missing? Plan HUMAN REVIEW before publishing, especially for content about people, and revise requests to be specific when that serves the purpose.

sections.skill: Compare stereotypes in outputs with a picture book that always shows the same roles

questions.prompt: Is any single page in the book false?
questions.intro: Imagine a children's picture book where every pilot is a man, every teacher is a woman, and every hero looks the same. No single page is false, since some pilots are men, but the WHOLE book teaches a narrow picture of who does what. Generated content can do the same: each image might look reasonable alone, but together they repeat a stereotype.

questions.prompt: What does the whole book teach?

sections.title: Apply it

sections.skill: Avoid both stereotypes and misleading overcorrection

questions.prompt: A tool inserts modern diversity into a photo-like image of a specific historical event where that is inaccurate. What is the problem?

choices.text: There is no problem at all, since images of history never need to be accurate for any purpose

questions.intro: Overcorrecting can cause problems too: inserting diversity that contradicts facts, such as a historical scene that did not look that way, misleads in a different direction. The goal is content that is accurate for its purpose and does not reduce people to stereotypes. Reviewers from different backgrounds notice different issues. Keep notes on recurring problems so future requests and checks improve.

questions.prompt: What is the goal for generated content about people?

choices.text: Accurate for its purpose, without stereotypes
As diverse as possible in every case, even when that contradicts the facts being shown
